---
title: "O3.4 Exclude 0% / 100% exposure — exploratory"
format: html
params:
  stage2_variant: "linear"
  refit_interior_exposure: true
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(glue)
library(here)
library(brms)
library(cmdstanr)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
child_data <- readRDS(here("data", "bilingual_hirt_stage2_data.rds")) |>
  filter(!is.na(theta_est))

child_full <- child_data |>
  filter(age >= 7) |>
  mutate(
    exposure_proportion = exposure_proportion / 100,
    exp_c = scale(exposure_proportion, scale = FALSE)[, 1],
    age_c = scale(age, scale = FALSE)[, 1]
  )

child_interior <- child_full |>
  filter(exposure_proportion > 0, exposure_proportion < 1) |>
  mutate(
    exp_c = scale(exposure_proportion, scale = FALSE)[, 1],
    age_c = scale(age, scale = FALSE)[, 1]
  )

n_full <- nrow(child_full)
n_int <- nrow(child_interior)

tibble(stage = c("full_sample", "interior_exposure_only"), n_rows = c(n_full, n_int))
```

Centring for `exp_c` and `age_c` is recomputed on the **interior** subsample so offsets match the sensitivity analysis.

# Refit stage 2 (same functional family as `params$stage2_variant`)

```{r eval=params$refit_interior_exposure}
stage2_theta_formula_linear <- bf(
  theta_est | mi(theta_se) ~ age_c * exp_c + (1 | child_id) +
    (age_c * exp_c | dataset_name * language)
)

fit_interior <- brm(
  formula = stage2_theta_formula_linear,
  data = child_interior,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
    prior(exponential(1), class = sd)
  ),
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 125,
  threads = threading(2)
)

saveRDS(fit_interior, here(
  "models",
  glue("bilingual_hirt_stage2_model_{params$stage2_variant}_interior_exposure.rds")
))
```

```{r eval=params$refit_interior_exposure}
stage2_theta_formula_log <- bf(
  theta_est | mi(theta_se) ~ age_c * log_exp_c + 
    (1 | child_id) + (age_c * log_exp_c | dataset_name * language)
)

fit_interior_log <- brm(
  formula = stage2_theta_formula_log,
  data = child_interior |> 
    mutate(log_exp_c = scale(log(exposure_proportion), scale = F)),
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
    prior(exponential(1), class = sd)
  ),
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(fit_interior_log, here("models", "bilingual_hirt_stage2_model_log_interior_exposure.rds"))
```

```{r}
loo_compare(
  loo(fit_interior),
  loo(fit_interior_log)
)
```


```{r eval=!params$refit_interior_exposure}
## Baseline (full sample, precomputed)
baseline <- readRDS(here(
  "models",
  glue("bilingual_hirt_stage2_model_{params$stage2_variant}.rds")
))

fixef(baseline)
```

After setting `params$refit_interior_exposure: true` and rendering, compare `fixef(fit_interior)` to the baseline RDS loaded above.
